links.outcome: Intent classification accuracy of GPT-4 versus LSTM and BERT on same test sentences
links.effect: GPT-4 few-shot accuracy 85.2% versus LSTM 73.7% and BERT 71.3%; GPT-4 over 15% better on ambiguous categories.
links.quote: GPT-4, which uses only a few examples (a few shots), attained a remarkable accuracy of 85.2%, considerably outperforming the LSTM and BERT models, which achieved accuracies of 73.7% and 71.3%, respectively.

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark comparing zero/few-shot GPT-4 to LSTM and BERT for classifying patient intent in cancer call-center transcripts, without testing a deployment practice.
